sloka: द्रक्ष्यामि त्वाम् वनात्र्पाप्तम् पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम् ।भद्रासनगतम् राम वनवासादिहागतम् ॥२-२५-४३॥
transliteration: drakṣyāmi tvām vanātrpāptam pūrṇacandramivoditam ।bhadrāsanagatam rāma vanavāsādihāgatam ॥2-25-43॥

translations.english: After you have fulfilled your father's words and returned from your exile I shall behold you seated on the throne, O Rama
